name: You.com Answer API
desc: One call that returns a cited answer with verbatim excerpts.
desc_zh: 一次调用返回带引用和原文摘录的答案
solves: A grounded answer normally means retrieval, page reads, prompts and a model choice. This API runs one search pass and hands back a Markdown answer with inline citations.
solves_zh: 要得到一个可追溯的答案，通常要自己串检索、读页面、写提示词还要选模型。这个 API 只跑一轮搜索，直接返回带内联引用的 Markdown 答案。
best_for: Your product needs a fast, checkable answer and you do not want to build the pipeline.
best_for_zh: 你的产品要一个又快又有出处的答案，而你不打算自己搭这套链路。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://you.com/docs/changelog (the vendor's own changelog directory)）。 The ledger holds only the You.com search engine (2021-12-01). You.com's API platform now also ships the Web Search API, Extract API, Research API, Finance Research API and Inference Router; the changelog only reaches back to 2026-07-15, so those earlier launches have no first-party date and are listed as unconfirmed in the report. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「Answer API」是通用词，带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://you.com/docs/changelog/2026/8/5
